menu.intro: Meet gözleme: a traditional Turkish flatbread, folded around savoury fillings and cooked until crisp outside, with melty cheese within.
menu.item1_description: Only cheese. Melty, comforting and golden from the griddle.
menu.item2_description: Cheese, plus your choice of mushroom, chicken, spinach, potato or beef.
menu.item3_description: Melty cheese, plus any two of your favourite fillings.

story.heading:
Small kitchen.
Big heart.
story.paragraph1: Rather than building a huge menu, we focus on doing one thing brilliantly. Every flatbread is made fresh to order, folded, filled and cooked until golden.
story.paragraph2: Best enjoyed straight off the griddle, with a proper cheese pull—and a warm welcome.
story.story_alt: Fiesta team cooking fresh gözleme on the griddle
story.caption: Real people. Really good gözleme.
